description:
Simplify your workflow by using ChatGPT to generate foundational Lucidchart diagrams directly from
your conversation. Beyond seamless diagram creation, this integration acts as a digital bridge, allowing
you to instantly search, retrieve, share, and summarize your existing Lucid documents right within
ChatGPT. Whether you are jumpstarting a new process map or extracting insights from complex boards,
you can now eliminate the bottleneck of context-switching and provide your AI with the visual context it
needs to accelerate your work.

defaultPrompt: Can you summarize my "Q2 Product Launch Planning Board Summary" from Lucid?
Use Lucid to create a flowchart for onboarding a new hire.
